text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A breathless, neck-and-neck battle!
Sakura Laurel claims the Kikuka Sho!
It's Sakura Laurel, victorious!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I did it. I—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(This result was surely obtained through
a mixture of all kinds of different factors.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (That's why next time won't end up "like this.")

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(In her next race, Brian-chan
will definitely surpass who she was "today"—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I want to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, I was only able to race because I happened to feel well.
I don't think I should treat this memory as the pinnacle of everything!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because for Brian-chan,
this isn't her peak yet.
choice_data_list: So running with her made you feel that way.
So running with her made you feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. If I delude myself into thinking this is my peak,
I will be left behind in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Did you hear? Narita Brian is
going down the classic middle-and-long distance route!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
So then, wrap up this year with the Arima Kinen,
and kick off next year with the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the Brian-chan who shows up then
will be even better than the one today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: By next spring, do you think the concerns with my legs will be resolved?

The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the ultimate showdown for stayers.
Sakura Laurel certainly has the talent for it, but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Of course—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —...Or so I'd like to say, but if you give in to your impatience, all your efforts will come to nothing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even if we simply decided to enter the race, it would be meaningless if we can't properly train to match it right now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I don't want it to end with me
suddenly falling sick on the day of the race!"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's hold off on making that our goal for now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Not yet.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind if I can't race next year.
Even if it ends up being the year after that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—that girl
will keep running ahead of me.

Sakura Laurel smiled gently.
She is always looking toward the future. And yet—
choice_data_list: (Her victory today was undoubtedly a triumph.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer?
choice_data_list: However, first of all, congratulations on winning the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...♪
Thank you very much.

I hold out my palm toward Sakura Laurel.
With a gentle smile, she brings her hand
against mine for a high-five.

A crisp, cheerful sound of shared joy
reverberated through the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
...! Biwa Hayahide was
discharged from the hospital on schedule!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's awesome!
I mean, see~? There was nothing to worry about after all~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
Then after the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
it's finally the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text: ...Moving on to our next story.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
...! We interrupt our scheduled broadcast
to bring you this breaking news.

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news. Biwa Hayahide, who was
running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
"Having suffered an injury to her left leg,
she announced that 'all future race plans
have been scrapped.'"

text_block_list.name: News Program
text_block_list.text:
While a direct showdown with Narita Brian at the Arima Kinen
was highly anticipated,
those plans have now all been canceled.
